historical_references.reference: Premprakash was a popular name for Jain monks during the 12th and 13th centuries in India. The name refers to the inner light or purity of the soul, often described as the 'inner Prem' and the 'inner Prakash'.

Premprakash was also a renowned poet and philosopher in the 15th century in Northern India. He was a follower of the Nath Yoga tradition and is known for his works on the spiritual path and self-realization.
